verdict.rationale: AWS ships an official, first-party CLI (v2) that controls multiple services from the terminal and automates them through scripts, with console-equivalent functionality. It also offers 'aws login' with console credentials, tab completion, auto-prompting and command history. A probe confirms the official install docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and explicit evidence of agent-oriented ergonomics such as structured machine-readable output or non-interactive agent workflows.
